CustomObject.description: One record per Experience Cloud site that hosts the Help Center / Resource Center components (unifiedLanding, helpArticlePage, resourceCenter, eventsPage). Keyed by the site's Network name; the paths are that site's page URL segments. ResourceCenterService.getLinkContext() reads it so c/contextNav keeps every link inside the site the user is on instead of jumping to the shared /help site (a separate login). A network with no row falls back to the shared site.
CustomObject.label: Help Surface
